issues.detail: Previous syntheses in Scheme 1 and retrosynthetic labels 1/1-prime in Scheme 2 are excluded. Scheme 6 mechanistic protonated/epoxide states are not counted as experimentally observed steps.
issues.subject: Schemes 1, 2, 6

issues.detail: THP acetal configurations are unspecified. Compound 6 is an inseparable diastereomeric mixture (article p7; SI S11); C9 is left unassigned. Bracketed 7 also has unspecified C9 configuration.
issues.subject: a2|a3|6|7

issues.detail: Abstract (p1) claims 99.9% ee; conclusion (p5) and experimental section (p7) report 99% ee. SI S15 shows a single integrated peak at 100.00 area percent, which is not independently converted into a precise ee.
issues.subject: 9 ee

issues.detail: The preparation of b states b4 5.04 g/2.4 mmol and vinyl acetate 3.5 g/3.6 mmol; reported masses and mmol values are inconsistent. Retain reported 78% yield without deriving corrected quantities.
issues.subject: E07

issues.detail: The preparation of 8 states compound 6 71 mg/0.8 mmol, inconsistent with C22H26O5; the product is 56 mg and reported 83%. No mmol correction is silently made.
issues.subject: E12

issues.detail: PPTS is reported as 3.65 g, 1.45 mmol, 0.04 equiv (article p5); these values are internally inconsistent.
issues.subject: E01

issues.detail: Schemes abbreviate conditions: E02 omits additional 15 h at room temperature; E10 omits 3 h room-temperature phase; final HCl hydrolysis is marked rt in Scheme 5 but 0-10 C experimentally. Structured steps use the detailed experimental section.
issues.subject: E02|E10|E13

issues.detail: 57% is combined 4-to-6 yield and 83% is combined 6-to-8 yield. No yield is copied onto internal steps. Table 1 86% for 4-to-5 belongs to a separate selected optimization trial.
issues.subject: E11|E12|E14

issues.detail: The paper calls the enzymatic step kinetic resolution. Drawn b4 is prochiral with equivalent CH2OH groups; normalized transformation is enantioselective monoacetylation/desymmetrization. This is a curator interpretation of terminology, not new experimental evidence.
issues.subject: b4-to-b

issues.detail: The file filed as SI-002 is a byte-distinct, text-identical duplicate of the 9-page main article; deduplicated using page text digest.
issues.subject: si-002.pdf

issues.detail: Model-assisted source transcription, RDKit canonicalization, formula/CIP checks and export validation are not independent expert admission. No atom mapping, atom balance or ORD submission certification is asserted.
issues.subject: all

issues.detail: The abstract 19% overall yield applies to the six-event assembled-fragment sequence. The calculated product of its reported yields is approximately 19%; it is not the total yield including both separately prepared fragment branches.
issues.subject: overall
